scheme_name: Financial Assistance For Allied Cultural Activities
other_conditions: Organization must be a not‑for‑profit entity (registered as a society under the Registration of Societies Act, a trust or a not‑for‑profit company) that has been in existence for at least three years
The organization must have been engaged for at least the past three years in presenting allied cultural spectacles on a regular basis and during festivals

A recommendation letter in the prescribed format must be obtained from the District Authority (District Magistrate/District Collector/Deputy Commissioner) or the relevant State/Union Territory authority
The organization must register on the NGO Darpan portal (https://ngodarpan.gov.in) and obtain a Unique ID before applying
benefits_summary: Up to ₹100 lakh for audio‑only equipment or ₹150 lakh for audio‑video equipment, covering up to 90 % of the project cost plus taxes and five years of operation & maintenance expenses.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from District Authority or State/UT authority in prescribed format
Proof of registration as a society, trust or not‑for‑profit company
NGO Darpan portal Unique ID certificate
